titulo_it: Essere, venire y andare en pasiva

bloques.titulo: The nuances of the three assistants
texto: **Essere**: «La porta è chiusa» (can be state: the door is closed, or passive action according to context).
**Venire (solo tiempos simples)**: «La porta viene chiusa alle dieci» (dynamic action: the door is closed / closed every day at 10: 00). No «*è venuta chiusa».
**Andare + participio**: «Questo modulo va compilato» (to be completed / to be completed); «Le regole vanno rispettate» (standards to be respected).

In certain contexts with verbs such as loss, distruggere or disperse, «andare» indicates an involuntary result or consummated damage: «Molti documenti storici andarono perduti durante l'alluvione» (Many historical documents were lost during the flood).

bloques.pregunta: In what verbal times is it possible to use «venire» as a passive voice auxiliary?

opciones.texto: Únicamente en los tiempos simples (presente, imperfetto, futuro, passato remoto)
opciones.explicacion: Never in forms composed of participle.

opciones.texto: In all the composite times accompanying the participle «stato»
opciones.explicacion: «Venire» does not support passive-function composite times.

opciones.texto: Exclusivamente en el modo subjuntivo de oraciones subordinadas
opciones.explicacion: It is used with full nature in indicative mode.

bloques.frase: Il modulo di iscrizione ___ compilato con molta attenzione entro domani.

opciones.explicacion: «Andare» in third person singular denotes mandatory need.
It would express a simple description of process without a burden of duty.
The word of permanence that does not build the passive of necessity.

bloques.frase: Molti archivi antichi andarono distrutti durante il grande incendio.

opciones.texto: Numerosos archivos antiguos resultaron destruidos y se perdieron de forma irreversible.
The files were peacefully transferred to a modern building.
opciones.explicacion: It completely ignores the meaning of destruction.

opciones.texto: The staff managed to rescue all the documents from the fire in time.
opciones.explicacion: Direct opposition to the sense of loss expressed.

bloques.pregunta: What's the difference between «La porta è chiusa alle dieci» and «La porta viene chiusa alle dieci»?

opciones.texto: «Viene chiusa» describe la acción dinámica de cerrarla, mientras «è chiusa» puede aludir a un estado resultante
opciones.explicacion: The «venire» auxiliary focuses the active process.

opciones.texto: Both sentences are identical and «venire» is only used to indicate physical movement to the door
«Viene chiusa» necessarily means that no one can approach the door

bloques.frase: Le clausole del regolamento condominiale ___ rispettate da tutti i condòmini.

opciones.explicacion: Third plural person agreed with «le clausole» in value of duty.
singular incompatible with the plural patient subject «le clausole».
Descriptive singular which lacks the required mandatory meaning.

bloques.frase: Il modulo va compilato con cura
bloques.traduccion: The form must be carefully filled out
bloques.explicacion: It orders the passive perifrase of obligation.

bloques.pregunta: What value does the verb «andare» acquire in «Le mie fatiche andarono sprecate»?

opciones.texto: Manifiesta un desenlace frustrante o un esfuerzo irremediablemente malgastado
opciones.explicacion: «Andare sprecato» indicates loss or uselessness of the result.

opciones.texto: He indicates that the protagonist had to take a tiring walk.
opciones.explicacion: It combines the figurative sense with space displacement.

opciones.texto: Expresa una obligación reglamentaria que los demás impusieron.
opciones.explicacion: There is no sense of mandate in this expression.

intro: In Italian, the passive voice has three assistants with very specific functional nuances: «essere» (neutral, usable in all simple and composite times), «venire» (used only in simple times to highlight the ongoing or dynamic action) and «andare» (followed by participle, expresses inescapable need or obligation, or irreparable loss of something).
